resources.string: The phone is charging, but the ship doesn\'t answer the hail
If it\'s moored to the ship, check:
When Android asks which app to open, choose myCar and tap Always: myCar takes the helm.
At each voyage myCar picks one of the two below: Bluetooth when your ship takes the phone\'s shanties that way, otherwise through myCar.
No question from Android at each voyage, and the ship\'s radio stays on. The phone\'s shanties reach the ship only if it takes them over Bluetooth: some ships take only calls that way.

The ship plays the phone\'s sound, over the cable or Wi-Fi. At each voyage Android asks to share the screen: one tap to accept. That permission is what lets myCar pass on the sound of your other apps.
